identityReviewRetry.reason: Three near-clone comparisons show repeated low-medium almond eyes, conventional straight fine noses and compact mouths; Othiles needs natural visible internal separation.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native age 20 and independent weight/male mass 0.5 each. Broad long oval, prominent long nose, muted green eyes, fine jaw stubble and short broken fringe.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Current Drenures has a narrow elongated lower face and fine nose with taller eyes. Marvenes/Vincantios have compact conventional nasal ends. Current Aeviles has broader nose/jaw and medium open eyes; avoid matching that combination.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Lengthen/project the narrow convex nose into a downward tip, use small low heavy-lidded eyes and wide shallow mouth above a wide flat chin. Keep short stubble/fringe but exclude them from proof.
